title: Electrical in waves: base to run and drive, then the display, the …
ask: Should the electrical build go in four waves with the factory cluster and a small interim GPS speedometer until the Display Unit (a), in three waves with the Display Unit in the base (b), or all at once as planned (c)?
options:
(a) Four waves, as listed. Wave 1 runs the car on the factory cluster with a small interim GPS speedometer (a 52 mm gauge, about $50), mounted where the Display Unit's bezel will hide its hole. The Display Unit, the Control Unit and the luxury wiring follow as money allows, each plugging into what wave 1 left ready. Cheapest start, and the firmware bench is off the critical path.
(b) Three waves: the Display Unit in wave 1, so the car drives first on its own cluster. Wave 1 costs about $700-1,000 more, and the display's bench proof (stage F) must be done before the first drive. No interim gauge.
(c) Build everything at once, as the plan stands.
recommend: (a), unless an interim gauge in the dash for some months bothers you - then (b)
